description: Delete the authenticated user's review for a game. Errors if the user has no review on this game. The fun score recorded via kineticist_set_fun_score is NOT removed by this — call kineticist_delete_fun_score for that. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

name: kineticist_delete_review
title: Delete your review
